scope: Add standalone 8-slot 16D factual key/value ring comparator and tests, preserving original P68 code, receipts, frozen source, scientific negatives and other lanes

mechanism.persistent_state: 2 tensors per world: 8x16 keys plus 8x16 last measured effects, exactly 256 float scalars; no out-of-band step/age/phase/counter
mechanism.key_norms: 0=empty, 1=occupied ordinary, 2=last MISS insertion marker; marker embedded in one existing key norm
mechanism.on_miss: first empty by lowest slot index; otherwise replace (last_insert_marker_slot + 1) mod 8; clear old marker by dividing prior norm-2 key by 2; mark incoming observed key by multiplying unit vector by 2
mechanism.on_hit: cosine similarity >=0.98, update that slot with actual just-observed effect; do not advance cursor
mechanism.on_read: normalize stored keys, cosine similarity >=0.98 and return observed effect, otherwise zero; no state update
mechanism.input: past actually executed simulated action and observed effects only; final query and held-out target unavailable during writes
mechanism.cold_restore: tensor-only carry from prior chunk produces bitwise identical state and prediction to uninterrupted factual stream
